statement: MediaTek's board approved a $5 billion U.S. financing budget for strategic expansion and supply chain support, alongside a first AI accelerator ASIC entering production in Q4 2026 and a second in high-volume production in 2028.
why: Committed financing behind a two-generation accelerator roadmap turns the Intel packaging design win from an intention into funded capacity that will draw on advanced-packaging supply.

impact.mechanism: A funded multi-generation ASIC roadmap adds committed order flow into advanced packaging and memory, expanding non-GPU accelerator supply from 2026 into 2028.

evidence.excerpt: first AI accelerator ASIC is on track for production

confidence.basis: Secondary earnings-call transcript; board approval of a financing budget is not the same as deployed capital.
